notes:
Supplied replication p. 13 is Table 3, body Results p. 9. Original study identifier and candy/page locator conflict; original primary unavailable. Replication estimates photographs, not amount poured. Rank-sum p=.037 belongs to a different test and was not paired with d.
Source follow-up: Published article; title and DOI match the assigned reference. Source text encodes equals as p and less-than as ! in statistical expressions. No conversion of the printed F statistic. Analytic N is left null: 105 recruited minus one documented exclusion implies 104 retained, but 104 is not printed as the target-test analytic sample and denominator df 99 remains unreconciled. Replication and reported_success are unassigned. Locator discrepancy: input study_o is 1, but the candy-pouring description and PDF p. 8 identify Study 3; Study 1 instead uses dots and shapes. Statistics here describe the located Study 3 test and do not establish a match to the supplied Study 1 identifier.
